name: semantic-links
description: Privacy-first semantic internal-link suggestions for Obsidian.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run verify:reproducible-build && node --check main.js && npm run validate:versions && npm run validate:repository && npm run stage:release && npm run validate:release-assets && npm run smoke:clean-vault
